Common.siteTagline: A transparent crowdfunding platform ensuring higher education for underprivileged students

Hero.titlePrefix: Ensure Higher Education for Deserving Students
Hero.description: Donate directly for tuition, exam fees, and hostel expenses of students verified by their faculty and institutions. Every penny accounted for in an open public ledger.
Hero.widgetDesc: Your contribution is automatically allocated to students with the most critical unpaid semester fees.
Hero.impact200: Covers essential exam stationery and library fees
Hero.impact500: Provides 1 month of subsidized mess food allowance
Hero.impact1000: Pays semester admission & hostel maintenance charge
Hero.impact2500: Covers textbook sets and exam registration forms
Hero.impact5000: Fully funds an entire semester of academic costs

HowItWorks.title: How Does Sadaqahbd Ensure 100% Transparency?
HowItWorks.subtitle: Every step from initial student application to final fund distribution is rigorously vetted.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: The student submits their crisis details with itemized academic and living expenses.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: A faculty member from the student's own department investigates and certifies need.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: The principal or head of institution gives final institutional authentication.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: 100% of donor funds reach the student directly with zero intermediaries and live ledger entry.

HadithVirtues.badge: In Light of Sahih Hadith • Authentic Guidance
HadithVirtues.title: Authentic Hadiths & Incomparable Virtues of Charity
HadithVirtues.subtitle: In authentic Hadiths of the Prophet (ﷺ), charity is declared a fountain of worldly blessings, a shield from trials, and a path to salvation in the Hereafter.
HadithVirtues.virtue1Desc: Just as water extinguishes fire, charity washes away and wipes out sins.
HadithVirtues.virtue2Desc: Secret charity cools the Lord's wrath and averts catastrophic ends.
HadithVirtues.virtue3Desc: Charity never diminishes wealth; rather, Allah infuses it with bountiful increase.
HadithVirtues.virtue4Desc: On the Day of Resurrection, the donor will find solace under the shade of Allah's Throne.
HadithVirtues.ctaText: Partake in this blessed charity — empower an underprivileged student's education
